a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both cover all 4,000 rows.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: NO NEW DRAW. The set-union of the three sealed official-population rosters, id for id: A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POP-500 (500 rows), A2T-TIER258-OFFICIAL-POP-1500 (1,500) and A2T-TIER3467-OFFICIAL-POP-2000 (2,000) = 4,000 rows, 500 per tier over all eight tiers. Each parent is that tier's own released population under the paper code's loader rule (for every query_* directory the first recording the released loader resolves; on tier 7 the FIRST user turn), sampled uniformly without replacement with seed 20260803. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_org1_union_roster.py, which verifies each parent's committed SHA-256 and re-derives both of its identity hashes before merging, then re-hashes every wav and re-reads every wav header.
a2t_calibration_pairing: Every one of these 4,000 rows already carries a SEALED official-protocol output under the compact registry, produced by SAEA-A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T172609Z-t1officialpop500), SAEA-A2T-TIER258-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T193726Z-t258officialpop1500) and SAEA-A2T-TIER3467-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T211040Z-t3467officialpop2000). A2T-ORG-1 is paired against those bytes; nothing is re-flown on the baseline side, because greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes on this runtime and the sealed bytes are therefore the only honest comparator.
a2t_calibration_strata: tier (500 per tier, all eight) and domain (smart_home 2,792, wearables 857, smart_car 351 over the union). Domain is recorded as counts in the roster receipt and resolved per sample at ANALYSIS time from each tier's released manifest, never at request time.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: 3,932 of the 4,000 sample ids are outside the immutable D1 identity closure and are carried by the additive receipt named above (docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-a2t-org1-union-4000.json, schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, 1,106,164,956 bytes of media). The other 68 are already inside docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json as part of the frozen 400 and are verified against it and skipped, because contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a supplement entry that duplicates a base D1 sample. A UNION supplement is required rather than a reference to the three predecessors': the gate accepts exactly ONE supplement path per run, each supplement is parented directly to d1-identity.json rather than chained, and the three sealed supplements are siblings covering 495 / 1,455 / 1,982 ids each.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: No new probe-sample receipt. All 4,000 sample ids already resolve inside data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe: 1,954 through docs/receipts/probe-samples/a2t-tier3467-official-population-2000.json, 1,423 through a2t-tier258-official-population-1500.json, 489 through a2t-tier1-official-population-500.json, 68 through r1-audio2tool-sample.json and 66 through the two 104-row post-seal AgentLoop scoring receipts. A receipt that repeated any of them would be refused as a duplicate.
a2t_calibration_exposure: Already-exposed discovery identities: every one of these 4,000 rows was contacted once on 2026-09-04 under the official protocol. This fragment grants no contact authority; docs/readiness/2026-09-05-a2t-org1-domain-grouped-registry-v1-preregistration.md and the exposure ledger do.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe.
a2t_calibration_longest_row_note: Four rows of this roster are the release's 654-second synthesis defect -- tier1_direct:003943 (654.6325 s), tier3_multi_intent:003555 (654.6325 s), tier6_correction:003151 (654.635667 s) and tier7_multiturn:001033 (654.635667 s) -- and they are KEPT, because the sealed baseline outputs they are paired against were produced on exactly these rows. Under the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule n_tokens = 13 * ceil(audio_seconds) the worst of them costs 8,515 speech tokens, which is what forces this cell's serving geometry; the prompt-fit receipt re-derives it against the grouped registry's own measured text envelope before any generation.
